Rogan meets him as a fellow foe of bans and scolds. Listeners get a big voice at ease. The library keeps the episode as a record of his visit.

Fauci, gain-of-function research, and Wuhan lab funding form the core of a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience. Rogan works through the fight over whether U.S. money, routed through grants, supported risky virus work in China. The argument sits at the center of the COVID origins war.

He lays out the claims and counter-claims: what gain-of-function means, what Dr. Fauci told Congress, and what the documents show. The segment is a dated but sharp record of the debate, useful for readers who want the critics' case assembled in one place, in the host's own combative order.
